features: Sound That Beats All: Hammer BeatBox soundbar for TV, mobile, and laptops comes power-packed with a 24-watt RMS Speaker
TWS Mode: With the TWS mode, you can connect 2 BeatBox soundbar that Lits Up The Party, and with it's changing RGB lights, this Bluetooth speaker bar is sure the party pal you need
Powerful Bass: The Boss like Bass on this Bluetooth Sound bar is sure to give you a loud and clear music experience with 4 button controls at your convenience
Connect And Play: This Hammer sound bar Bluetooth speaker has wide compatibility. BeatBox plays songs via BT, AUX, USB, and TF Card
Two Sound Drivers: This Hammer BT Soundbar for TV comes with a BT5.3 version and two 52 mm Sound Drivers; live the sound with BeatBox
8 Hours Of Playback: This Hammer wireless soundbar comes with Universal Type-C charging and gives you up to 8 hours of melody and tunes, non-stop
Converse with the BeatBox: Now with an in-built mic, this Bluetooth Speaker for TV allows you to take calls hands-free
